Less Confusing C++

June 2017 · Learning & research

I rewrote my school’s C++ coursework as a free book.

Read the book ↗Archived site · 26 August 2019 ↗

Dates & sources

June 2017 is the publication date recorded in the existing portfolio, rather than a verified manuscript start date.

I was frustrated with the study material for my introductory C++ course. I thought the structure could be much clearer, so I wrote the book I wanted to learn from.

I made it free because I was writing for other students. You can read Less Confusing C++ on Leanpub.
